project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 3 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment completed 2026-08-11: 5 of 5 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; unresolved entries were individually checked and retained as unknown.

townGuide.headline: A practical local guide to Broughton Astley
